items.headline: Cardell Williams throws for a TD with 2:11 left and Maryland adds late FG to beat Wisconsin 24-21
items.description: — Backup quarterback Cardell Williams ran for two touchdowns and threw for the tying score with 2:11 remining as Maryland beat Wisconsin 24-21 on Saturday to secure back-to-back conference victories for the first time since 2023.

items.headline: Maryland QB Malik Washington doesn't start vs. Wisconsin
items.description: Maryland quarterback Malik Washington did not start against Wisconsin as he continues to deal with a lower-body injury.
